title: OpInf-LLM: Parametric PDE Solving with LLMs via Operator Inference
abstract: arXiv:2602.01493v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Solving diverse partial differential equations (PDEs) is fundamental in science and engineering. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in code generation, symbolic reasoning, and tool use, but reliably solving PDEs across heterogeneous settings remains challenging. Prior work on LLM-based code generation and transformer-based foundation models for PDE learning has shown promising advances. However, a persistent trade-off between execution success rate and numerical accuracy arises, particularly when generalization to unseen parameters and boundary conditions is required. In this work, we propose OpInf-LLM, an LLM parametric PDE solving framework via operator inference. translated_title: OpInf-LLM：通过算子推断利用大语言模型求解参数化偏微分方程
translated_abstract: 求解多样化的偏微分方程（PDE）是科学与工程领域的基础任务。大语言模型（LLM）在代码生成、符号推理和工具使用方面已展现出强大能力，但在异构环境下可靠地求解PDE仍然具有挑战性。此前基于LLM的代码生成研究以及基于Transformer的PDE学习基础模型已取得可喜进展。然而，执行成功率与数值精度之间始终存在权衡，尤其是在需要对未见过的参数和边界条件进行泛化时。在本工作中，我们提出了OpInf-LLM，一个通过算子推断实现大语言模型参数化PDE求解的框架。该框架利用少量解数据即可对多样化的PDE实例（包括未见过的参数和配置）进行准确预测，并可与LLM无缝集成，实现自然语言交互（原文在此截断）。
tldr: 提出OpInf-LLM框架，将算子推断与大语言模型结合，仅需少量解数据即可准确求解参数化偏微分方程，并能泛化到未见过的参数与边界条件，缓解了执行成功率与数值精度之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: OpInf-LLM introduces an LLM-based parametric PDE solving framework via operator inference, which leverages small amounts of solution data to accurately predict diverse PDE instances—including unseen parameters and boundary conditions—while mitigating the trade-off between execution success rate and numerical accuracy.
